'''2007 Corellia Regionals David McCune LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 Corellia Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Dave McCune
* '''Deck name:''' Tournament Senate
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
